_note: Weights, limits and labels are the team's own design choices, NOT official bank policy. Write the reason for each one in the project report.

components.label: Owner experience (years)
components.reason: More years of experience lowers the chance of execution mistakes

components.label: Years operating
components.reason: A longer track record shows the business survives

components.label: Expected growth
components.reason: Growth plans help, but owners are often optimistic, so the weight is low

components.label: Debt service coverage (DSCR)
components.reason: Shows if profit can pay the installment. 1.0 is the break-even point

components.label: Profit margin
components.reason: Higher margin leaves more room for bad months

components.label: Owner contribution
components.reason: More owner money means the owner shares the risk

components.label: Break-even safety margin
components.reason: How far sales can fall before profit stops covering the installment

components.label: Cash buffer (months of installments)
components.reason: Spare cash keeps daily operations running when sales dip

components.label: Number of employees
components.reason: A larger team means less dependence on one person

components.label: Years operating
components.reason: Established routines make daily running smoother

readiness.reason: Money matters most for financing readiness, so the financial score counts double. Team choice, not bank policy.
